## Test plan

- [ ] Tests, lint, format check and build run, or exceptions explained
- [ ] Relevant user-visible behavior checked, or limitations explained

## Mutation UI (when applicable)

- [ ] Visible accessible pending state or safe optimistic update; background exceptions documented
- [ ] Duplicate/conflicting actions, errors and uncertain outcomes handled
- [ ] Optimistic rollback, concurrent requests and relevant realtime events tested
- [ ] Timeout / unresolved outcomes distinguished from confirmed failure; bounded reconcile
- [ ] Session change, stale read cursor / replayed events, and upload fallback (known and unknown byte total) tested
- [ ] Cache updates and invalidation justified, including the infinite message timeline
